During the formation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], an '''industrialist''' of considerable wealth placed a hit on the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], as revenge for the latter [[Death/Legends|murdering]] [[Unidentified wealthy industrialist's son|his only son]]. He sent out nine [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]], eight of which ended up dead at Vader's hand. After their failures, the industrialist went desperate and had the [[Unidentified elite assassin|ninth assassin]] kill Vader.

==History==
[[File:Unidentifiedwealthyindustrialist2.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The industrialist after paying the price to hire the assassin.]]
The industrialist, shortly after the [[Declaration of a New Order]], was forced into renegotiating contracts with various businessmen, with [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] personally overseeing the arrangement. This resulted in them being forced into making concessions to members of a [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]]-based company. His [[Unidentified wealthy industrialist's son|son]], and only heir, attempted to stop the business transaction by shooting the representatives, but Vader used his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to deflect the shot, and [[Death/Legends|killed]] him. The father was deeply angered at Vader for this, and decided to have Vader [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]] as revenge for his loss. Some time later, the industrialist was accompanied by eighteen hired guns to escort him through a swampy [[Planet/Legends|planet]] to find his newest contracted killer, due to his previous eight having failed to kill Vader, of which only three were confirmed dead. The [[Unidentified elite assassin|assassin's]] [[Unidentified assassin's associate|associate]] denied him entry, although while he was begging to see him, his entire mercenary force was killed silently by the assassin himself. Upon finding that all of the force was dead, and the assassin demanding that he leave, the man begged to hire him, willing to pay any price to satiate his vengeance. Upon agreeing to the terms, the industrialist, in order to meet with the term of "not seeing nor hearing the assassin again," had his eyes gouged out and heavily bandaged, and his ears meeting a similar fate, and then left for his mining facility, satisfied at the thought that his son would be avenged.

Eventually, Vader found the man after disposing of the assassin he hired, although the man had allegedly committed suicide. In reality, Vader arrived at the mining facility, acting as the assassin. When Vader entered the industrialist's office, he gave him, instead of his mask, the assassin's helmet. The industrialist immediately realized it was Vader, and he allowed Vader to kill him with his lightsaber, as he had failed to avenge his son.
